title: Ship an AI-Built iOS Game with Solver and Snapshot Gates
summary: OkSun790 describes shipping a Claude Code-assisted iOS game by treating CLAUDE.md as durable project memory, preserving artist-replaceable tile hooks, and validating every level with a headless solver and snapshot runner. An iOS team can encode design decisions, gameplay invariants, and export repairs so each agent session resumes from evidence instead of rediscovering the build.
takeaway: Store approved design rules as project memory, gate every level with a solver, render reproducible snapshots, and script away export changes that would otherwise break signing.
